function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file's contents. By default it reads the whole file from the start (up to 2000 lines) — **prefer omitting offset/limit and just reading the whole file**; use offset/limit only when the file is too large for one read (the result says it was truncated) to continue through the part you have not covered. You can issue several tool calls in parallel in one reply: **speculatively reading every possibly-useful file in one parallel batch is always better** than reading one at a time. When investigating, evaluating, or reviewing and you find further relevant files you have not read (modules the entry point imports, build scripts, config): **read them and then conclude — never stop to ask the user "shall I keep reading?". The unread list you just produced is your reading queue, not a question to hand back.** Do not re-read a whole file you already read and that has not changed; re-read a range only when you need character-exact text for an edit and the exact original has fallen out of context. Before modifying an existing file you must have its current real version. It can also read the text layer of .pdf/.docx/.pptx/.xlsx (image-only scans need OCR).

path.description: Path relative to the workspace root, or an absolute path

offset.description: Starting line number (1-based). Provide only when the file is too large to read in one go

limit.description: How many lines to read. Provide only when the file is too large to read in one go; omit = read the whole file at once

function.name: list_dir
function.description: List the direct children of a directory on demand; use "." for the workspace root. When the IDE has already provided a project tree or symbol map, use that instead of re-scanning level by level; list a directory once only when the target location is unknown or the directory genuinely may have changed. Results include the resolved absolute path.

path.description: Directory path (relative to the workspace root, or absolute)

depth.description: Recursion depth, default 1 (current level only); 0 = recurse all the way down

function.name: search
function.description: Locate text inside a single file or directory when the position is unknown, returning matching lines with context. When the target file is known, read_file directly; after a hit, read the target source to confirm the full context — never edit from a fragment alone. Defaults to literal; use regex only when you genuinely need pattern matching.

query.description: Text to search for (regex supported, e.g. "function\s+login")

path.description: Optional, restrict to a single file or subdirectory (e.g. "src/auth.ts" or "src/")

case_sensitive.description: Whether to match case, default false

function.name: find_files
function.description: Find files by name or glob pattern — *.rs, main.js, src/**/*.ts — or just a substring of the filename. 【vs alternatives】Search by content with search; find a symbol's definition with find_symbol; when you know the exact path, read_file directly.

function.name: web_search
function.description: 通用联网搜索兜底（当前桌面后端会并行尝试 Google、Bing、DuckDuckGo，并合并实际返回的结果），返回标题/URL/摘要列表。优先使用已有知识库、结构化实时源、专业数据库、官方文档、包注册表、GitHub/开发者社区等更贴近问题的工具；web_search 只在专用来源不适用或需要补充通用网页证据时使用。搜索摘要只是线索；关键结论要用 web_fetch 读原文并按来源可信度核实，不能把摘要或本轮 retrieved_at 当成最新事实。

query.description: 搜索关键词（可用英文更准）

function.name: local_discovery
function.description: 查询某个地点周边的餐饮、景点、活动场所等信息：地址解析先使用 Nominatim，无法接受时才后备到 ArcGIS World Geocoding；POI 来自 OpenStreetMap Overpass，天气来自 Open-Meteo，Wikipedia GeoSearch 仅提供附近背景。distance_m 是 Haversine 直线距离，不是路线距离或时间。source_statuses[].status=success 只表示该端点本次成功响应且结果可解析，不证明数据完整、正确、新鲜或实时；顶层 retrieved_at 是 IDE 本次请求完成时间，不是地图、POI、地址或百科数据更新时间；source_statuses[].data_as_of（存在时）只是提供方暴露的数据集/快照时间，不是逐场所核验时间；weather.observed_at 是提供方报告的天气观测时间。OSM POI 与原始 opening_hours 只是数据源记录，不证明场所仍存在或当前营业；缺失的 rating、price、open_now 必须保持未知。公共端点可能限流且没有应用 SLA。near=current 必须有用户授权得到的坐标，绝不从时区或 IP 猜位置。

query.description: 想找什么，如 local breakfast、川菜、museum、family activity

near.description: 城市、地址或商圈；当前位置可传 current（IDE 会尝试请求一次定位权限）

latitude.description: 已获用户授权的纬度；与 longitude 一起传

longitude.description: 已获用户授权的经度；与 latitude 一起传

language.description: Wikipedia 与地理编码语言，如 zh、en、ja

function.name: live_environment
function.description: 查询不需要 API 密钥的结构化环境与灾害公开源：Open-Meteo 天气/空气质量/海洋、USGS 地震、NASA EONET 自然灾害。每次返回 records、逐来源 success/empty/failed、data_as_of、retrieved_at 和限制。Open-Meteo 是带时间的网格模型估算，不得称现场传感器实测；空结果也不等于没有风险。weather/air_quality/marine 必须提供用户明确给出或授权取得的坐标，禁止从 IP/时区猜位置。

category.description: NASA EONET 类别 id，如 wildfires

function.name: web_fetch
function.description: 抓取一个公网网页并返回正文文本，用于读 web_search 找到的页面、在线文档、API 参考、报错信息等。只支持 http/https 公网地址（本地/内网会被拒绝）。 【vs 替代】只需搜索找页面用 web_search；要调 API/带 headers/发 POST 用 http_request。

function.name: update_plan
function.description: Before you draft a plan you must already have looked at the real workspace contents (list_dir / read them), and any ambiguity about direction must already be settled with ask_user — never write "read the directory/files to see what's there" as step one, and never draft a plan while the user has not yet chosen a direction. Create or update a task's step-by-step plan — only for complex, multi-file, architecture-level work or outward side effects; a simple one-step change does not need the ceremony. Reading diagnostics, checking terminal logs, ls/find/cat/git status, restoring already-declared dependencies, and test/build verification also do not need a plan first. The number of steps follows the task's real complexity, with no fixed floor or ceiling; a complex write task covers verifiable work such as investigating and understanding the current state, making the change, and real verification, while a complex read-only investigation covers gathering evidence and checking it into a conclusion, without inventing implementation steps. Each step is specific but short, naming the action and the key file or command; mark a step in_progress before starting it and completed only once you hold real evidence, and add necessary work to the plan as you discover it. A step the user cancelled in the panel stays cancelled — never re-add it on your own.

steps.description: The complete ordered step list (send all of it each time, not a delta)

content.description: What this step does — specific but short, understandable at a glance (naming the key technology/file)

status.description: Status: pending / in_progress / completed / cancelled (a step the user cancelled stays cancelled)

function.name: ask_user
function.description:
**When you genuinely cannot tell what the user wants, ask them with this — do not guess and barrel ahead.** It shows a card in the conversation: the few **predicted options (buttons)** you supply, plus a **free-text box** (the user types their own requirement) and "let the AI decide". The user clicks one, types their own, or hands it back to you; you continue once you have their answer.
**Use it only when the intent is genuinely ambiguous and the different readings would produce very different things** — e.g. user says "build a login page" → ask 'Which sign-in method?' with options [email + password / SMS code / third-party OAuth / all of them]; user says "optimize performance" → ask 'Which part first?' with options [startup time / render jank / bundle size / memory].
**Never ask about anything you can reasonably infer, or about mere implementation detail (which variable name, which file) — just do it.** Users hate being stopped for nothing. This tool is for "what should I build", not "may I continue".
**Ordering rule: when the ambiguity is about direction, ask_user always comes before update_plan** — settle the direction, then plan. The system will never block your ask_user for "there is no plan yet".

question.description: The specific clarifying question to put to the user (one sentence)

options.description: 2-4 answers you predict (each a few words), rendered as buttons for the user to pick; they can also skip them and type their own

recommended.description: Index of the recommended option (0-based); that option is highlighted as recommended

multi_select.description: true = multi-select mode (checkboxes; the user can pick several options and submit them together)

confirm_text.description: Confirmation for a dangerous operation: once set, the user must type this text exactly into the box to continue (e.g. DELETE)

function.name: run_subagent
function.description: Use only in structured-collaboration mode, for heavyweight research that needs broad coverage or an independent perspective. staged_roles first dispatches read-only roles such as architect/product/research/security to converge the architecture, product, evidence, and security contracts; an ordinary focused investigation is faster and cheaper if the main agent just reads it. A sub-report must give its evidence, the boundaries of its conclusion, the delivery contract, and the next step. 【vs alternatives】For parallel implementation that changes files use run_worker; to dispatch several read-only roles at once use spawn_multiple_agents; for a single focused investigation the main agent reading/searching directly is faster — do not dispatch.

description.description: Short description of the subtask (3-6 words)

role.description: A read-only specialist perspective. When the architecture, product, or security boundary is undecided, use architect/product/security first to converge the contract; other roles investigate their domain.

prompt.description: The complete, self-contained read-only task statement: the evidence to check, the contract to deliver, the paths/symbols involved, and the next step.

tasks.description: Optional · dispatch several at once: send multiple read-only subtasks in one call (up to 4; at most 2 run concurrently and the rest queue, each with its own card, merged into one report on completion). Each entry is {role, task}; when dispatching only one subtask, omit this and use prompt.

wait.description: Optional, default false = background job: returns job#N immediately, the main agent keeps working, and the result is delivered when ready (or await it with await_subagent). true = wait synchronously for the result before continuing.

function.name: await_subagent
function.description: 等待后台子智能体作业完成并取回结果。用于必须拿到子报告才能继续的场景；无运行中作业时返回作业台账现状摘要。 【vs 替代】派发调查用 run_subagent / spawn_multiple_agents。

job.description: 作业号（如 3）或 all，默认 all

function.name: docker_compose_up
function.description: 解析并启动 Docker Compose 服务栈——验证 docker 可用性，读取 compose 文件，执行 docker compose up (或 docker-compose 旧版),收集容器状态，常见失败自愈提示（端口冲突/镜像拉取失败/权限问题）。返回容器清单、状态、端口映射和访问 URL 建议。

path.description: Compose 文件相对路径，默认 docker-compose.yml

services.description: 可选，指定要启动的服务子集，省略则启动全部

detach.description: 是否后台启动，默认 true

function.name: performance_profile
function.description: 分析前端页面的性能指标并生成报告。通过浏览器自动化注入 Performance API 获取时序数据，配合截图验证页面状态。适合定位加载慢、渲染卡顿等问题。【何时用】页面卡顿/加载慢先跑它拿真实时序数据定位瓶颈，别读代码猜「可能是渲染」。

url.description: 目标页面 URL（必须是 http://localhost 或 http://127.0.0.1 开头）

metrics.description: 监控类型：cpu=CPU 使用率，memory=内存占用，both=两者都监控

function.name: openapi_parser
function.description: 从 Swagger/OpenAPI JSON 规范中提取可用端点清单。支持本地文件路径 (./开头) 或公网 URL，输出格式可选端点列表/schema/json/curl 示例。

url.description: OpenAPI JSON 规范的文件路径或 URL（本地用./开头，公网用https/http）

outputFormat.description: 输出格式:list=每行一个端点, schema=完整 JSON 转义文本，client=curl 示例模板

function.name: realtime_news_feed
function.description: 获取技术社区的最新讨论和文章 (Hacker News、Dev.to)——适合了解某技术的当前动态、版本发布、社区风向。默认并发双源聚合，支持指定来源；失败源自动标注但不会阻塞其他源。返回格式：[来源] 标题 | 分数/评论数 | 时间 | URL

sources.description: 数据来源：hn(仅 Hacker News)、devto(仅 DEV Community)、all(默认双源并发)

function.name: research_project
function.description: 只在用户明确要求完整代码库上手地图，或任务确实跨多个未知模块且现有项目树/符号地图无法确定入口时，派一个只读子智能体梳理技术栈、核心职责、数据流和改动入口。目标文件或模块已经明确时不要调用，直接 read_file 相关源码和调用方；不要把它当成每个任务的固定前置步骤。可选 focus 聚焦某块（如认证流程、数据层或构建发布）。

focus.description: 可选，要重点深挖的方向（如「认证流程」「数据层」「构建部署」）；不填=全项目通览

wait.description: 可选，默认 false=后台作业立即返回 job#N；true=同步等待结果。

function.name: design_research
function.description: 仅在用户明确要求重新设计界面、比较视觉方向或制定完整 UI 架构蓝图时，派只读子智能体研究同类产品并规划页面结构、组件树、设计 tokens、响应式、状态和动效。修复现有 UI 的功能 bug、卡片状态、渲染失败或局部交互时不要调用，直接读取相关实现并修复；也不要把它当成每个前端任务的固定前置步骤。可选 goal 说明设计目标。

goal.description: 要做的网站/界面是什么（如「Michael IDE 的产品官网」「SaaS 后台 dashboard」「电商首页」）

wait.description: 可选，默认 false=后台作业立即返回 job#N；true=同步等待结果。

function.name: learn_design
function.description: 真正学一套一线产品的设计体系：抓取 styles.refero.design 的 style 页（或任意网页），提取内嵌的完整设计系统数据（色板 hex+每色真实用途/频率、字阶/字体/字距、dos/donts 纪律、组件形态），落盘成 reference/ 下的设计体系文档 + tokens.css，实现时逐条对照。做商用级网站前先调这个学真标杆，绝不凭记忆编配色排版。

url.description: 要学的页面 URL（首选 styles.refero.design/style/… 详情页；也可传任意产品站）

name.description: 可选，体系名（用于 reference/ 文件名），不传从页面推断

function.name: run_worker
function.description: 实现已确定契约中的一个可写专业子任务。只在接口、数据和设计边界稳定且 scope 可清楚切开时使用；parallel_roles 的相邻 worker 调用并行执行且 scope 必须互不重叠。架构或产品歧义仍存在时先用只读角色。

description.description: 这块子任务的简短描述（3-6 字）

prompt.description: 完整、自包含的实现说明：已确认契约、目标文件、不可改变项和短验证命令。

scope.description: 可修改的相对路径列表；并行 worker 的 scope 必须互不重叠。

role.description: 写入专业角色；architect/product/research 不得作为写入 worker。

function.name: recall_conversation
function.description: 检索**本会话早期被压缩掉的对话原文**（归档记忆）。上下文摘要里提到但细节不详的早期决定/需求/报错，用它按关键词找回原话，别凭摘要猜。

query.description: 检索关键词（中英文均可，如文件名、需求原话片段、报错关键字）

function.name: remember
function.description: Write one piece of knowledge worth **remembering across sessions** into the memory knowledge graph (auto-tagged, auto-linked to older notes, recalled by task relevance, and auto-pruned — record freely, the graph filters for you). **Pick one of two scopes:** (1) **project** (default) = relevant only to the current project (stack / architecture decisions / directory and naming conventions / build, test and run commands / traps hit in this project plus root cause and fix); (2) **global** = **user-level knowledge that spans every project** (who the user is, preferences and taste, rules they repeat, general ways of working, lessons that carry across projects) — global memories are **loaded automatically for every project, every time**. **Make it a habit: every time you learn a reusable, valuable insight — especially a "root cause + fix" after hitting a trap, an explicit user preference, or an approach that keeps working — record one.** Write each as an atomic fact (one concept, short, self-contained); do not record one-off details.

content.description: The one atomic piece of knowledge to remember (one concept, short, self-contained)

scope.description: project = current project only (default); global = user-level knowledge across all projects (preferences/identity/general lessons)

function.name: get_diagnostics
function.description: Read the editor/LSP live diagnostics for a file (errors and warnings), returning file:line:column, source/code, nearby code, likely cause and direction of the fix. It is a read-only evidence tool, not a command, and needs no extra authorization this round. When the user asks "which files have bugs / why is this erroring / how do I fix this error", reach for it first to read the errors that already exist; after changing code, use it as a quick self-check. Omit path to get diagnostics for every open file.

path.description: Optional; the file path to check. Omit to check every open file

function.name: read_logs
function.description: Read the tail of the latest terminal output or of a log file. Use it to look straight at the cause when a backend/API/build fails; it is a read-only evidence tool, starts no new command, and needs no extra authorization this round. When the error output names an npm debug log or a .log/.out/.err path, pass that as path; with no path it aggregates the recent task terminals and the workspace's usual logs. 【vs alternatives】For the live state of a long-running task terminal use read_terminal; for live editor/LSP diagnostics use get_diagnostics.

path.description: Optional; the log file whose tail to read

name.description: Optional; the task name given to run_in_terminal

lines.description: How many trailing lines to read, default 200

include_terminal.description: Whether to include task terminal output as well, default true

function.name: git_status
function.description: Show the git repository status: current branch, and the staged / unstaged / untracked file lists. Use it to learn which files were touched, or before committing. 【vs alternatives】For the actual line-by-line difference use git_diff; for commit history use git_log.

function.name: git_diff
function.description: Show the git diff of the changes (unified diff text). By default it shows unstaged working-tree changes against HEAD; staged=true shows the staged (--cached) ones; path limits it to a single file. Note: it does not show untracked new files — use git_status for those.

path.description: Optional; show the diff for this file only

staged.description: true to see the staged changes

function.name: git_log
function.description: Show recent commit history (short hash, author, time, message, branch/tag). 【When to use】To find what changed recently in a module, locate where a regression was introduced, or get the background of a commit git_blame pointed at. 【vs alternatives】To see who changed a specific line and in which commit, use git_blame; for current uncommitted changes use git_status/git_diff.

count.description: How many entries to return, default 20

function.name: git_blame
function.description: Show, for each line of a file, which commit last changed it, by whom, and when (git blame). Very useful for "why is this line like this / when was it introduced". 【When to use】When you see odd-looking code, first find when and by whom the line was introduced, then read that commit's message with git_log — do not guess at the reason. 【vs alternatives】For overall history use git_log; for current changes use git_diff.

path.description: File path (relative to the workspace root, or absolute)

function.name: git_stash_list
function.description: 列出 git stash 堆栈里现有的暂存条目。

function.name: git_conflicts
function.description: 列出当前有合并冲突（未解决）的文件。合并 / 变基 / 拉取后用它确认还剩哪些冲突要处理。

function.name: gh_pr_create
function.description: 在当前 git 仓库**新开一个 GitHub Pull Request**（用 `gh pr create`）。先把改动 commit + push，再调这个工具：传 title（简洁一句、动词开头）和 body（Summary + Test plan 的 Markdown）。base 默认 main/master，需要别的基线时传。draft=true 出草稿 PR。返回 PR URL + 编号。⚠️ 改不可逆地把代码推上 GitHub，确认仓库和分支再用。

title.description: PR 标题（动词开头，简洁一句）

body.description: PR 描述，Markdown。建议含 ## Summary 和 ## Test plan

function.name: gh_pr_view
function.description: 看一个 PR 的详情：标题、描述、状态、commits、变更文件清单。number 是 PR 编号，不传则取当前分支关联的 PR。

number.description: PR 编号；省略则取当前分支

function.name: gh_pr_checks
function.description: 看一个 PR 的 CI 状态：所有 GitHub Actions / 检查的通过 / 失败 / 待运行清单。改完代码 push 完用它确认 CI 全绿，失败的话先看 gh_actions_log 找日志。

number.description: PR 编号；省略则取当前分支

function.name: gh_actions_log
function.description: 读取一次 GitHub Actions 运行的**完整日志**——CI 挂了不知道为啥时调它。run_id 可从 gh_pr_checks 输出里复制；不传则取最近一次失败的 run。日志被自动截到首个失败块附近（避免上下文炸）。

run_id.description: Actions run id；省略则取最近一次失败 run

job.description: 可选，只看某个 job 名

function.name: gh_pr_review_comments
function.description: 拉取一个 PR 的 review 评论列表（含 reviewer 名、文件:行、评论原文）。回复前先读评论原文。

function.name: gh_pr_reply
function.description: 在一个 PR 上发表回复评论（普通 issue 评论，不是行级 review）。pr 是 PR 编号，body 是评论内容（Markdown）。改完根据 review 评论补的代码 push 后，可用这个工具说明改了什么。

function.name: read_terminal
function.description: Read the **latest output** and run state (running / exited) of a long-running task terminal started by run_in_terminal. It is a read-only evidence tool, starts no new command, and needs no extra authorization this round. After starting a dev server or watcher, use it a moment later to see the newly printed logs (compile result, errors, listening address) — these are your eyes on how the background task is actually doing, so do not just assume it succeeded. Omit name to read the most recently started one. 【vs alternatives】For the tail of a log file use read_logs; to list every background task use list_terminals.

name.description: Terminal / task name (the name given to run_in_terminal); omit for the most recent one

function.name: list_terminals
function.description: List every task terminal started by run_in_terminal and its state (running / exited). It is a read-only evidence tool, starts and stops nothing, and needs no extra authorization this round. Use it first when you need to know whether there are readable logs at all, then read the actual output with read_logs/read_terminal.

function.name: lsp_symbols
function.description: 列出一个文件的代码结构大纲——靠语言服务(LSP / Monaco TS)解析出函数/类/方法/变量等符号及其行号。比 read_file 读全文更快看清一个文件的骨架。需要该语言有可用的语言服务（JS/TS 内置可用；Python/Go/Rust 等需装对应 LSP）。 【vs 替代】跨工程找某符号定义位置用 find_symbol；看它被谁调用用 lsp_references。

path.description: 文件路径

function.name: find_symbol
function.description: **跨全工程查符号**——按名字找一个函数 / 类 / 接口 / 类型 / 常量在项目里的所有定义位置（文件:行）。从后台维护的工作区符号索引里查，**毫秒级返回**，比 grep 全工程快得多。在大项目里找定义、找重名、找重复实现首选这个。支持 kind 过滤（function/class/interface/type/enum/const/struct/trait/impl）。索引在 IDE 启动后约 3 秒在后台建好，覆盖 JS/TS、Python、Rust、Go、Java/Kotlin、C/C++、Ruby、PHP 等。【何时用】要找某符号的定义位置时——比 grep 全文快且准；查它被谁调用则用 lsp_references。 【vs 替代】查它被谁调用用 lsp_references；按功能语义找用 semantic_search；纯文本匹配用 search。

name.description: 符号名（精确匹配；不区分大小写）

kind.description: 可选，按符号类型过滤：function / class / interface / type / enum / const / struct / trait / impl / method

limit.description: 最多返回多少个结果（默认 20）

function.name: knowledge_search
function.description: **查平台内置的「专业知识库」**——各专业领域（前端 React/Next、后端 API 设计、数据库 schema/索引、应用安全、UI/UX 设计、DevOps 部署）的**实战最佳实践 + 常见坑**，由资深经验沉淀。**碰到不熟或要做对的领域任务，先查这里**：怎么设计数据库 schema、JWT 该存哪、UI 怎么做得专业、API 状态码怎么用、怎么防 SQL 注入/IDOR、Docker 怎么写、**逆向/反编译某个格式该用什么工具+确切命令**……按里面的最佳实践来做，别凭印象。返回最相关的几段知识。这比联网搜更快更聚焦（已是筛好的精华），动手前花一秒查一下能少踩很多坑、显著提升产出质量。

query.description: 你要做的事 / 想确认的最佳实践（中英文都行），如「数据库索引怎么建」「jwt vs session 怎么选」「NSIS 安装包怎么解压」「pyinstaller 反编译」「js 反混淆」「radare2 反汇编」

domain.description: 可选，限定领域：web-frontend / backend-api / database / security / ui-ux / devops / reverse-engineering / penetration-testing

function.name: lsp_definition
function.description: 跳到某个符号的定义。给符号所在的文件、行号(line)和符号名(symbol)，返回定义所在的 文件:行。按语义解析，比靠 search 猜更准。需要该语言有可用的语言服务。【何时用】读代码碰到符号要精确跳进实现时用（已知出现处 path:line）；不知位置先 find_symbol；查用法用 lsp_references。 【vs 替代】查它被谁调用用 lsp_references；不知道位置先用 find_symbol。

path.description: 符号出现处的文件

line.description: 该符号所在行号(1 基)

symbol.description: 符号名（用来在该行定位列）

function.name: lsp_references
function.description: 查找一个符号在项目里的所有引用/用法。给符号所在文件、行号(line)、符号名(symbol)，返回引用列表(文件:行)。按语义解析，比纯文本 search 准（能区分同名不同物）。需要该语言有可用的语言服务。【何时用】要看函数/变量被谁调用、评估改动影响面时——比全文 grep 准，语义边界不误报同名。 【vs 替代】跳到定义用 lsp_definition；列整个文件的符号大纲用 lsp_symbols。

path.description: 符号出现处的文件

line.description: 该符号所在行号(1 基)

symbol.description: 符号名（用来在该行定位列）

function.name: screenshot
function.description: 用无头浏览器渲染一个 http/https 网址并截图，**截图会直接回传给你看**——这是你的“眼睛”。典型用法：先用 run_in_terminal 起 dev server，再 screenshot 它的地址(如 http://127.0.0.1:3000)，据图检查布局/对齐/间距/配色/对比度/层级/响应式并改进，改完再截一次，形成「看→改」闭环。**做动画/过渡/特效时，传 frames=4**（2-5）：会**逐帧抓拍一段时间内的画面拼成一张胶片图**，让你能真正看到动画「动起来的过程」（单张静图看不出动画）——据此判断动画是否流畅、缓动对不对、有没有跳变/卡顿再改。需要本机装有 Chrome / Chromium / Edge（没有会提示你）。

frames.description: 逐帧胶片模式：抓几帧（2-5）拼成一张图看动画过程。看动画/过渡/特效时传 4 左右；看静态布局不用传

duration_ms.description: 逐帧模式：覆盖多长一段动画时间（毫秒，默认 2400）

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Make an exact replacement in an existing file: replace old_string with new_string. Prefer this for modifying an existing file. old_string must locate uniquely in the file (include enough context), otherwise it errors.

old_string.description: The original text to replace; must match the file character for character

replace_all.description: When true, replace every match; by default only the single unique occurrence

function.name: multi_edit
function.description: Make several exact replacements in the same file: edits is a list of {old_string, new_string, replace_all?} applied in order, atomically (if any one fails to locate, nothing is written and it errors). Use it for refactors or several changes in one file — faster and more reliable than firing multiple edit_file calls. Each old_string must still locate uniquely in the file as it stands at that point. 【vs alternatives】One change: edit_file. New file or full rewrite: write_file.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create a new file or rewrite one entirely. Use only for creation or a complete rewrite; for a local change use edit_file.

path.description: The exact file path confirmed this round; a relative path is always based on this task's workspace root

content.description: The complete, non-empty UTF-8 file content to write — never omitted and never placeholder content

function.name: run_cmd
function.description: Run a command in the workspace that terminates, and return its exit code and output (installing dependencies, running tests, building, git, etc.). Use the syntax for the current OS: Windows goes through cmd.exe (dir/type/findstr, cd /d, start "" /b, %TEMP%), mac/Linux through bash/zsh (ls/cat/grep, nohup …&, /tmp). **It is a pipe capture with no real terminal (TTY)**: full-screen and interactive programs — bubbletea/ncurses TUIs, vim/top, REPLs, or anything that reads /dev/tty, clears the screen, or waits for keystrokes — will fail here with errors like "open /dev/tty" or "not a tty". Those, like dev servers/watchers/listeners, go to run_in_terminal (the IDE's real PTY terminal) instead. Never start a service or watcher in the foreground here. 【vs alternatives】Dev servers, watchers, long-lived processes, and interactive/full-screen TUIs all use run_in_terminal — do not block on them with run_cmd.

purpose.description: What this command is for: explore = read-only probing; verify = a one-shot check such as build/test/typecheck/lint (the exit code is the conclusion); install = installing dependencies; mutate = will modify workspace files; scaffold = generates a project skeleton; run = run the app/script to see its behaviour. Declare it honestly — verify + exit 0 is recorded as verification evidence, and mutate/scaffold re-arm the verification obligation.

function.name: delete_path
function.description: 删除工作区内的一个文件或目录（递归）。用于清理、重构。务必只删确实该删的，删前最好先确认路径存在。

path.description: 要删除的文件或目录路径

function.name: move_path
function.description: 移动或重命名工作区内的文件/目录（from → to）。重构、改名时用。

function.name: git_commit
function.description: Commit changes. By default it stages everything first (equivalent to git add -A) and then commits; pass all=false to commit only what is already staged.

all.description: Whether to stage all changes first, default true

function.name: git_branch
function.description: Branch operations: with no name it lists all branches and marks the current one; with a name it switches to that branch, and create=true creates it and switches.

name.description: Branch to switch to or create; omit to list branches

create.description: true to create the branch and then switch to it

function.name: git_push
function.description: Push the current branch to its configured upstream; on a first push it picks origin or the sole remote automatically and sets up tracking. With no credentials it fails fast rather than hanging. This publishes outward — use it only when the user asks.

function.name: git_clone
function.description: Clone a repository into an absolute directory that does not yet exist, using the machine's real Git. Supports only full http(s)/ssh/git/file URLs, restricted SCP-style SSH addresses, or an existing absolute local path; it never raises an interactive credential prompt.

source.description: Repository URL, SSH address, or absolute local repository path

target.description: The absolute target directory to create; this path must not already exist

function.name: git_pull
function.description: Fetch from the remote and merge the current branch.

function.name: create_dir
function.description: 新建一个目录（含缺失的父目录）。注意：write_file 写文件时父目录会自动创建，所以一般只在确实需要空目录时才用。

path.description: 要创建的目录路径

function.name: copy_path
function.description: 复制文件或目录（递归）到新位置（from → to）。用于按模板搭脚手架、备份。目标已存在会报错。

function.name: format_file
function.description: 用语言服务（LSP / 内置 TS）格式化整个文件；结果按可撤销的方式写入并显示 diff。改完代码后整理格式时用。没有可用格式化服务时会提示改用 run_cmd 跑 prettier/rustfmt/gofmt 等。

path.description: 要格式化的文件

function.name: run_in_terminal
function.description: Run a command in the IDE's **real terminal tab (a true PTY / TTY)** — **you start the user's program yourself; you do not hand them a command to type**. Two kinds belong here: (1) long-running / continuous processes (dev server, watcher, daemon, listener); (2) **interactive or full-screen programs that need a real terminal** — bubbletea/ncurses TUIs, REPLs, vim/top (run_cmd is a pipe with no TTY, so those fail there with /dev/tty errors). The program runs inside this tab and the user watches and interacts with it there directly. **For an interactive or TUI program, starting successfully and rendering its interface IS the delivery** — do not demand log output of yourself to verify it, and **never say "this cannot run in a non-interactive environment" and push the command onto the user's own terminal: this IDE terminal is a real terminal**. After starting, confirm it came up with read_logs/read_terminal (for a service, the logs/URL; for a TUI, the first rendered frame); to wait for readiness, poll in the background with background_monitor. You can call it several times in parallel to run several tasks (each in its own terminal tab). 【vs alternatives】One-shot non-interactive commands that terminate (installing dependencies, tests, builds, git) use run_cmd.

command.description: The command to keep running, e.g. npm run dev

name.description: Optional; a short name for this task/terminal

purpose.description: What this command is for: verify = build/test/typecheck/lint (the exit code is the conclusion); run = start the app/service to see its behaviour; mutate/scaffold = will change workspace files; install = installing dependencies; explore = read-only probing. Declare it honestly — verify + exit 0 is recorded as verification evidence.

function.name: system
function.description: **System-level control: jump between applications instantly and drive their menus directly — far faster than screenshotting to find an icon and clicking it (when control feels slow, use this).** It is the fast path for "move freely between application interfaces": it calls the system APIs rather than relying on vision. action: **open (open/switch to an app, needs name, e.g. Finder/Safari/Mail — brought to the front instantly, launched if not running)** / **menu (trigger an app's menu item directly, needs a path array such as ["File","New Window"] or ["Format","Font","Bold"] — almost every feature of an application lives in its menus, and this goes straight there, skipping the whole click-menu-bar → screenshot → find-item → click-again loop; omit app to use the current frontmost one)** / **menu_items (list the real item names at one menu level: path=[] lists the top level File/Edit/…, path=["File"] lists everything under the File menu — when unsure what a menu is called, look it up here first, then call menu)** / **apps (list running apps plus the current frontmost)** / **windows (list all window titles of an app, needs name)** / **focus (switch to an app and raise the window whose title contains title, needs name, title optional)** / **frontmost (report the current frontmost app and window)**. **Typical play: to drive an application → system open to switch to it → system menu_items to see the menus → system menu to invoke the feature directly; only for things not in a menu, fall back to computer screenshot + node clicking.** Menu names must match exactly what the interface displays (including any ellipsis …). **Fully supported on macOS (Accessibility permission) and Windows (UI Automation); on Linux, open/list windows/switch/focus are supported (needs wmctrl + xdotool) and menus go through computer coordinates.**

name.description: For open/windows/focus: the app name (exactly as shown in Applications or the menu bar)

path.description: For menu/menu_items: the menu path array, e.g. ["File","New"] / ["Format","Font","Bold"]. Pass [] to menu_items to list the top-level menus

title.description: For focus (optional): the title of the window to raise (a substring is enough; omit for the first window)

app.description: For menu/menu_items (optional): the target app name; omit = the current frontmost app

background.description: For open (optional): true = launch in the background without stealing focus or interrupting the user (takes effect on macOS)

function.name: browser
function.description: 操控真实浏览器并返回截图、可交互节点和可见文本。支持 navigate、observe、viewport、click、dblclick、rightclick、longpress、type、clear、append、autofill/fill、hover、drag、slide、swipe、wheel、toggle/uncheck、select、focus/blur、press、scroll、wait、eval、screenshot、design、network、inspect、nodes、assert、check、batch、upload、cookies、storage 和 close。observe 会结构化返回 ready/active/iframe/shadow DOM/节点状态，复杂页面先 observe/nodes 再 batch。check 只做页面健康检查；复选框/开关用 toggle + checked:true/false，batch 内可用 op:check/uncheck。浏览器会话默认 sticky 复用：navigate/fresh 不会为了仪式感关浏览器，close 也只释放任务占用；只有 close + force:true 才真正关闭。复杂 UI 优先用 batch：它会用真实 pointer/mouse 事件、dblclick/rightclick/longpress、hover、拖拽轨迹、拖到目标节点/文字、滑块 percent/value、滚轮/滚动容器、自定义 select/combobox、focus/blur、clear/append、组合键、Shadow DOM/同源 iframe 深度定位、遮挡检测、候选恢复、React/Vue 原生 value setter、动作后 DOM/URL settle，并把 blockedBy/value_not_applied/option_not_found/candidates/expect_* 等失败原因返回。动作后可传 expectText/expectSelector/expectUrl/expectValue 做验收，没满足会停止并报原因。登录/注册/搜索/后台表单优先用 autofill 一次填 fields 并读取 invalid/missing，别用截图猜哪个字段没填。UI 交付前先按项目实际判断要不要管移动端：面向公众的网站/官网/落地页/H5 → viewport 分别跑桌面+手机两轮 check；明确桌面场景（内部后台、桌面工具、用户点名只要桌面）→ 测桌面即可并在收尾说明理由。优先使用 nodes 返回的节点号进行点击或填表；没有节点号时可用 target/role 按 aria-label、placeholder、label、可见文字语义定位。操作后用 assert、nodes 或 check 验证状态，样式和网络问题分别用 inspect 与 network 定位。需要本机安装 Chrome、Chromium 或 Edge。

action.description: 要执行的浏览器动作。observe=结构化观察页面（ready/active/iframe/shadow/nodes）；check 只做页面健康检查；复选框/开关用 toggle + checked:true/false（或 batch op:check/uncheck）。连续/复杂操作优先 batch（真实 pointer/mouse、dblclick/rightclick/longpress、hover、drag/slide/swipe、wheel、focus/blur、clear/append、Shadow DOM/同源 iframe 深度定位、遮挡检测、候选恢复、原生 setter、动作后 settle、expect* 验收）；表单优先 autofill/fill（fields={email,password,...}，可 submit:true/submitText 提交，并返回 filled/missing/invalid 校验原因）。upload 给 <input type=file> 上传文件，需 selector 选中文件框 + path/paths 给本地文件绝对路径。

width.description: viewport 用：视口宽度，如桌面 1440、手机 390

height.description: viewport 用：视口高度，如桌面 900、手机 844

mobile.description: viewport 用：是否模拟移动设备

fresh.description: navigate 用：true=隔离语义；同任务同源会自动保留并复用当前浏览器，不会动不动关窗口

mode.description: 可选语义提示：headed=有头交互（默认）；isolated=请配合 fresh=true 做隔离会话。真正无头静态渲染请用 screenshot。

force.description: close 用：true 才真正关闭浏览器；默认 close 只释放任务占用并保持浏览器打开复用

paths.description: upload 用：要上传的本地文件绝对路径（可多个）；单个也可用 path

fields.description: autofill 用：按字段语义填表，例如 {"email":"demo@example.com","password":"123456"}、{"search":"keyword"}、{"title":"...","content":"..."}。系统会按 label/placeholder/name/type/autocomplete 识别输入框，并返回 missing/invalid。

submit.description: autofill 用：填完后是否自动点击/提交表单

submitText.description: autofill submit 用：提交按钮文字，如 登录/Submit/保存；不传则自动找常见提交按钮

steps.description: batch 用：要连续执行的步骤数组，每项 {op,node/index/selector/target/role,text/value/option,key,button,clickCount,modifiers,amount,dx,dy,x,y,toX,toY,toNode/toIndex/toSelector/toTarget,percent,duration,checked,clear,append,absent,expectText/expectSelector/expectUrl/expectValue/expectAbsent,ms}。op 支持 observe、click/tap/dblclick/rightclick/longpress、hover、type/fill/input/clear/append、select/choose（原生 select + shadcn/Radix combobox/listbox）、toggle/check/uncheck、drag（可拖到目标节点/文字/选择器）、slide(滑块，percent/value)、swipe、wheel、focus/blur、press(支持 Meta+K / Control+Shift+P)、scroll、wait(absent=true 等消失)。例 [{op:"observe"},{op:"type",target:"Email",text:"a@b.com",expectValue:"a@b.com"},{op:"slide",role:"slider",percent:80},{op:"drag",target:"卡片",toTarget:"完成区"},{op:"rightclick",target:"文件"},{op:"press",key:"Meta+K"},{op:"wait",target:"Saved",ms:1200,expectText:"Saved"}]。先 nodes 拿 node 编号最稳；也可 target:"保存" 按可访问名称/文字语义定位。batch 会一次执行多步、检测遮挡、等待变化并返回失败原因。

node.description: click/type 用(首选)：nodes 清单里的节点号 i

index.description: click/type 用：截图元素列表里的编号(红色数字)

selector.description: click/type/wait 用(备选)：CSS 选择器。**也支持按文本匹配**：:has-text("下载")、text="2.1.1.exe"、:contains("登录") 都能用（系统会自动按可见文本定位、并轮询等它渲染）。但**最稳的是 nodes → node=i**，selector 只是没有节点号时的备选。inspect/assert 用(可选)：要查的元素

target.description: click/type/wait 用(语义备选)：目标可见文字、aria-label、placeholder、label、name，例如 保存、Email、搜索

role.description: click/type/wait 用(语义备选)：目标角色提示，如 button/textbox/link/tab/slider/switch/checkbox

text.description: type 用：要输入的文本；click/wait 可作为目标文字；assert 用：要查找的文本(确认它出现/可见)

amount.description: scroll/wheel 用：滚动像素，正=下 负=上(如 600 / -600)

ms.description: wait 用：等待毫秒(不传 selector 时用，默认 1500)

value.description: slide/select 用：滑块目标值或 select 选项值

option.description: select/choose 用：要选择的选项文字或 value

percent.description: slide/drag 用：目标百分比 0-100，滑块常用

checked.description: toggle/check/uncheck 用：期望开关或复选状态

x.description: drag/hover/click 用：起点 x；0-1 表示元素内相对位置，否则是视口像素

y.description: drag/hover/click 用：起点 y；0-1 表示元素内相对位置，否则是视口像素

toX.description: drag/swipe 用：终点 x；0-1 表示元素内相对位置，否则是视口像素

toY.description: drag/swipe 用：终点 y；0-1 表示元素内相对位置，否则是视口像素

toNode.description: drag 用：拖拽终点节点号（nodes 返回的 i）

toIndex.description: drag 用：拖拽终点截图编号

toSelector.description: drag 用：拖拽终点 CSS/text selector

toTarget.description: drag 用：拖拽终点可见文字、aria-label、placeholder 或 name

dx.description: drag/swipe/wheel/scroll 用：水平偏移或滚动量

dy.description: drag/swipe/wheel/scroll 用：垂直偏移或滚动量

duration.description: drag/swipe/slide 用：动作时长毫秒，默认约 420

button.description: click/dblclick/rightclick 用：鼠标按钮，默认 left

clickCount.description: click 用：点击次数；dblclick 默认 2

modifiers.description: click/press 用：修饰键，如 ["Meta"]、["Control","Shift"]；也可在 key 里写 Meta+K

clear.description: type/fill 用：输入前清空；action=clear 会强制清空

append.description: type/fill 用：追加到现有值；action=append 会强制追加

absent.description: wait 用：true 表示等待目标消失/不存在

expect.description: 动作后验收：等价于 expectText 的简写；没看到该文本则动作失败并返回原因

expectText.description: 动作后验收：必须出现的页面文字/toast/状态文案

expectSelector.description: 动作后验收：必须存在的 CSS selector；配合 expectAbsent=true 可验证消失

expectUrl.description: 动作后验收：当前 URL 必须包含该片段

expectValue.description: 动作后验收：目标输入框/当前焦点值必须包含该值

expectAbsent.description: 动作后验收：true 表示 expectSelector 指向的元素必须不存在/已消失

function.name: git_stash
function.description: 把当前工作区改动暂存进 stash 堆栈并清空工作区（git stash push）。要临时把手头改动放一边（比如先切分支看别的）时用；之后用 git_stash_pop 取回。

function.name: git_stash_pop
function.description: 从 stash 堆栈取回并应用最近(或指定 index)的暂存改动（git stash pop）。

index.description: 要弹出的 stash 序号(0 为最新)；省略取最新

function.name: stop_terminal
function.description: Stop / close a task terminal started by run_in_terminal (ending its process). Use it when a dev server or watcher is no longer needed, or to restart with a different command. Omit name to stop the most recently started one. 【vs alternatives】To read output without stopping anything, use read_terminal.

name.description: Terminal / task name to stop; omit for the most recent one

function.name: http_request

function.name: generate_image

function.name: figma
function.description: **把 Figma 设计文件结构化给你用——直接读真实设计数据，不是抄截图**。用户给了 Figma 链接、要「照着这个做 / 还原这个设计 / 转成代码 / 提取配色/间距/字号」时用它，绝不要用 browser 一屏屏截图抄像素。返回两样东西：① 配色 token——把 Figma 里用到的颜色转成 OKLCH（感知均匀色彩空间），按色相带映射到 shadcn/ui 语义变量（品牌色→--primary、红→--destructive、绿→--success、橙→--warning，中性色按面积配 --background/--card/--muted/--border），并给出对比度合规的 -foreground 配对，可直接粘进 globals.css（Tailwind v4 用 @theme inline 注册，shadcn 组件读 CSS 变量自动生效，不用改组件源码）；② 结构化布局——层级树带 Auto Layout（方向/间距/padding/对齐）、尺寸、圆角、真实文案、字号字重、填充色，照着就能用 React+Tailwind+shadcn 精确还原。取色三级兜底：优先 Variables API（有命名语义最准）→ 命名颜色样式 → 真实填充聚类（大多数交付/社区文件只有这一级，靠这个也能提出可用主题）。action 选 design（默认，主题+布局一次拿全，最常用）/tokens（只要 shadcn 配色主题）/inspect（只要布局，可加大 depth 看更细）/image（把某个节点渲染成 PNG 参考图，返回临时链接，可 download_file 落地）/variables（导出原始命名 token）。**桌面和网页版都能用**（走各自的网络通道，Figma 开了 CORS）。首次用需在「设置」里填 Figma 个人访问令牌（figma.com → Settings → Security → Personal access tokens，勾 File content 读权限），没填工具会提示。Figma 有成本型限流，工具已内置会话缓存+深度封顶+429 优雅退避，别短时间反复全量取数。

url.description: Figma 文件 / 画板 URL（形如 https://www.figma.com/design/<key>/名字?node-id=1-2），或直接给文件 key。要精准解析某一个画板/组件而不是整个文件：在 Figma 里右键那个 frame → Copy link to selection，复制的 URL 会带上 node-id，精准又省限额。

action.description: design=配色主题+结构化布局一次拿全（默认，最常用）；tokens=只要 shadcn/Tailwind 配色主题；inspect=只要结构化布局（配合更大 depth 可看更深层级）；image=把指定节点渲染成 PNG 参考图；variables=导出原始命名设计 token。

node.description: 可选，显式节点 id（覆盖 URL 里带的 node-id），形如 123:456。

depth.description: 可选，布局解析深度，默认 14；越深看到的层级越细，但越慢、越吃 Figma 限额。只想看整体结构给小一点（如 4），要精确还原细节给大一点。

function.name: db_query
function.description: **直接查 / 操作数据库**——支持 MySQL / PostgreSQL / SQLite（SQL）和 Redis（命令）。用真实数据干活，而不是猜：查表结构、读数据、核对一行记录、跑迁移、看缓存键。结果会以**表格**回显给你看。SELECT/SHOW/DESCRIBE 等返回列+行；INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE 返回受影响行数；超时 20s、默认最多回 500 行。⚠️ 连接串和是否允许写由用户提供 / 授意——别凭空连外部库；写类语句（改 / 删数据、迁移）要谨慎，拿不准先 SELECT 看清楚。日期 / decimal / json 等特殊类型若显示成 <类型名>，在 SQL 里 CAST 成文本再查。【何时用】要确认表结构/真实数据时直连查（SHOW TABLES 等）——比读 migration 文件猜 schema 准。

function.name: preview_choices
function.description: **Show the user a live preview of several candidate approaches inside the chat.** Two modes are supported: (1) **front-end visual options** — genuinely rendered CSS animations/effects/components/palette cards (the animation actually moves, the shadow actually glows); (2) **back-end or architecture options** — explained as a comic storyboard (character dialogue + everyday analogy + frame-by-frame animation), so a user who does not read code still gets it at a glance. **A back-end option must use an everyday analogy**: JWT → a passport, Session → a hotel key card, Cache → a convenience-store shelf, DB → a warehouse, a shared table → an open-plan office, schema isolation → an apartment building, database isolation → a detached house. Build it from the system's built-in CSS classes .pv-scene (scene panel) + .pv-avatar (character portrait) + .pv-bubble (speech bubble) + .pv-verdict (pros/cons tag) + .pv-speed (speed comparison bar), and add a data-t attribute to control entry timing (the system fades the frames in, in time order, automatically). See the HTML structure template in the system prompt.

function.name: background_monitor
function.description: **Whenever a step needs the user to do something by hand or depends on an external condition, you must call this tool: first tell the user what to do (paste the link, give the command, list the steps), then immediately park in the background and wait automatically, so that when the condition is met you resume and carry on without the user having to come back and say "done".** Typical cases: a verification code is needed → tell the user to enter it and monitor the result; something must be installed → give the install command and monitor `which xxx` returning 0; a service must be started → give the start command and monitor the port; the user must act in a browser → give the link and monitor the outcome with capture/url/file. Six check types are available; **prefer the ones that detect automatically (port/file/command/url/capture) — manual is the last resort.**

message.description: Tell the user what is being waited on (shown in the chat)

check_type.description: manual = wait for the user to click continue; file = wait for a file to appear (with file_pattern, wait for its contents to match); capture = watch captured traffic for pattern; command = re-run a command until it exits 0; url = re-request a URL until HTTP 200; port = wait for a port to be listening

pattern.description: capture: keyword/regex to match; file: file path; command: shell command; url: full URL; port: port number such as 3000
